q: Which HTML5 element represents self-contained content, such as a news story or blog post, that could be distributed independently?
exp: <article> is the semantic element for independent, self-contained content.

q: A div uses the default content-box model with width: 200px; padding: 10px (all sides); border: 5px (all sides); margin: 20px. What horizontal space does the visible box (content + padding + border, excluding margin) occupy?
exp: 200 + 2×10 + 2×5 = 230px; margin is outside the box.

q: Which HTTP status code indicates that a new resource has been successfully created, typically in response to a POST request?
exp: 201 Created is returned when a request results in a new resource being created.

q: What is the result of typeof null in JavaScript?
exp: typeof null returns "object"; this is a long-standing quirk of the language.

q: The first web browser, written by Tim Berners-Lee in 1990, was named:
exp: Berners-Lee's first browser/editor was called WorldWideWeb (later renamed Nexus).

q: Which input type should be used in an HTML5 form to accept only numeric values and show a spinner control?
exp: HTML5 defines type="number" for numeric input with up/down controls.

q: Which of the following is a valid JSON object?
exp: JSON requires double-quoted keys and strings and does not allow trailing commas.

q: What does document.getElementById("abc") return if no element has the id "abc"?
exp: getElementById returns null when no matching element exists.

q: Which of the following is NOT a constraint of the REST architectural style?
exp: REST requires statelessness: each request carries all needed information, so server-side session state is not part of REST.

q: In the URL https://www.example.com:8080/docs/index.html?id=5#top, which part is the query string?
exp: The query string follows '?' and precedes '#'; here it is id=5.

q: Which attribute is used to merge a table cell across three rows?
exp: rowspan makes a cell span the given number of rows; colspan spans columns.

q: In CSS, what does the selector p > span select?
options: All span elements inside any p at any depth
A span immediately following a p
Every span that is a direct child of a p
exp: The child combinator '>' selects only direct children.

q: Which of the following is executed on the web server before the page is sent to the browser?
exp: PHP is a server-side language; its output is sent to the client as HTML.

q: AJAX stands for:
exp: AJAX = Asynchronous JavaScript and XML.

q: In a search engine, which component follows hyperlinks and fetches web pages so that they can be indexed?
exp: A crawler (spider/bot) discovers and downloads pages for the indexer.

q: Which tag is essential for making a page scale properly on mobile devices in responsive design?
exp: The viewport meta tag tells mobile browsers to match the device width and set initial zoom.
The dot is the concatenation operator, so the strings "5" and "3" join to give 53.

q: Which of the following is NOT a semantic element in HTML5?
exp: <div> has no meaning on its own; nav, footer and aside describe their content.

q: Which HTTP method is idempotent and is normally used to replace an existing resource completely?
exp: PUT replaces the target resource with the supplied representation; repeating it gives the same result.

q:
What is the output?
console.log(2 + "3" - 1);
exp: 2 + "3" gives the string "23"; "23" - 1 coerces to number giving 22.

q: Which value of the CSS position property positions an element relative to the browser viewport and keeps it in place while scrolling?
exp: position: fixed is positioned relative to the viewport and does not move on scroll.

q: A well-formed XML document must have:
exp: Well-formedness requires a single root element, properly nested and closed tags.

q: The World Wide Web was proposed and developed at CERN by:
exp: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the Web at CERN in 1989-90.

q: In which type of web hosting does a customer rent an entire physical server exclusively for their own use?
exp: Dedicated hosting gives one customer the whole physical machine.

q: When a form is submitted with method="GET", the form data is:
options: sent only in the request body
appended to the URL as a query string
exp: GET appends name=value pairs to the URL after '?'.

q: What does document.querySelector(".box") return?
options: A live HTMLCollection of all matches
The first element matching the selector
exp: querySelector returns only the first matching element (or null); querySelectorAll returns a NodeList.

q:
Match the HTTP status codes with their meanings:
P. 301   Q. 403   R. 503
1. Forbidden
2. Service Unavailable
3. Moved Permanently
exp: 301 = Moved Permanently, 403 = Forbidden, 503 = Service Unavailable.
var is function-scoped, not block-scoped, so the inner assignment changes the same x; output is 2.

q: In SOAP-based web services, WSDL is used to:
options: describe the operations, messages and endpoint of the service
exp: WSDL (Web Services Description Language) is an XML description of a service's interface.

q: Which HTML5 element provides a scriptable region for drawing graphics using JavaScript?
exp: <canvas> is the HTML5 drawing surface controlled through the Canvas API.

q: Given: li {color: red;} .item {color: green;} #first {color: blue;} and the element <li id="first" class="item">, what colour is the text?
exp: An id selector has higher specificity than a class selector, which beats an element selector.

q: Which JavaScript object was traditionally used by AJAX to send asynchronous HTTP requests?
exp: XMLHttpRequest is the classic browser object for AJAX calls.

q: What is the default port number of the HTTPS protocol?
exp: HTTPS uses TCP port 443 by default; HTTP uses 80.

q: The PageRank algorithm used by the Google search engine was developed by:
exp: PageRank was devised by Larry Page and Sergey Brin at Stanford.

q: Java servlets are executed by:
options: a servlet (web) container such as Apache Tomcat
exp: A servlet container manages the life cycle of servlets on the server.

q: Which element is used in an HTML table to group the header rows of the table?
exp: <thead> groups header rows; <th> defines a single header cell.

q:
What is the output?
console.log(typeof NaN);
exp: NaN is a special numeric value, so typeof NaN is "number".

q:
Statement I: HTTP is a stateless protocol.
Statement II: Cookies can be used by a server to maintain state across HTTP requests.
Which is correct?
options: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
exp: HTTP does not remember earlier requests; cookies and sessions add state on top of it.

q: The CSS rule @media (max-width: 600px) { ... } applies when:
options: the viewport width is at least 600px
the viewport width is 600px or less
the output device is a printer
exp: max-width: 600px matches viewports whose width is up to and including 600px.
